title: The Last Uniform
author: Ines Iversen
blurb: Rafael Marchetti, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
